mapper.update: UPDATE oms_order SET status = 1, payment_time = NOW(), pay_type = #{payType}, modify_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 0 AND delete_status = 0
UPDATE oms_order SET status = 4, modify_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 0 AND delete_status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT status FROM oms_order WHERE id = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT o.id FROM oms_order o WHERE o.status = 0 AND o.delete_status = 0 AND o.create_time < DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -#{minute} MINUTE) AND o.id > #{afterId} ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oms_order_pay_anomaly (order_id, order_sn, member_id, order_status, pay_amount, notify_amount, trade_no, pay_type, reason, raw_params, handle_status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{orderSn}, #{memberId}, #{orderStatus}, #{payAmount}, #{notifyAmount}, #{tradeNo}, #{payType}, #{reason}, #{rawParams}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE handle_status = handle_status
mapper.select: SELECT id AS sku_id, sku_code, stock, lock_stock, CASE WHEN stock IS NULL OR lock_stock IS NULL THEN 'NULL_FIELD' WHEN stock < 0 OR lock_stock < 0 THEN 'NEGATIVE' WHEN lock_stock > stock THEN 'LOCK_GT_STOCK' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS anomaly_type FROM pms_sku_stock WHERE stock IS NULL OR lock_stock IS NULL OR stock < 0 OR lock_stock < 0 OR lock_stock > stock ORDER BY id
